name: Spring Meadow Acres
description: In 262 Cold Spring Road, PA, Spring Meadow Acres grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a working pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
